value.canaryBoundary: Shadow-only comparison over the same real phase return and evidence; trusted route remains controlling; no second authoring pass, no semantic work duplication, no agent-role stratification, and no inspection of prompts, reasoning, tool order, decomposition or intermediate drafts.
value.governanceTaxBudget: At most one marginal machine command per eligible return; clean-agreement audit sample at most 20 percent and at most 4 cases; zero duplicated semantic work; no provider calls; unavailable timing evidence blocks a cost-saving claim rather than the safety observation.
value.nextAllowedMove: Independently review the P4-D0 canary design. Acceptance may authorize separate R1B work-order authoring, but R1B implementation and P4 canary execution remain closed until their own checkpoints.
value.claimBoundary: Design-only checkpoint. No R1B authoring or execution, actual canary run, phase-route authority change, lifecycle activation, downstream application, provider/live/network, public-sync, deployment or production action is claimed.
